review_scope: same-session independent economic critic; source and synthetic controls, no primary outcomes inspected
recommendation: Freeze the reviewed source and declared protocol before primary outcomes; no further optional audit expansion is necessary. This verifies numerical invariants under explicit assumptions, not commercial adoption or complete cost identification.
preserved_failed_control_note: Audit 01 contains two fixture-precondition failures: adoptionHours was newly added and defaulted to a positive cost, preventing the intended zero-construction control from investing. The control now explicitly fixes adoptionHours and adoptionInferenceCents to zero. Audit 01 is retained; it is not evidence of an unresolved market-code failure.

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Attempt count was labeled observed accepted history in investment forecast
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Market owner changed weeklySales to actual accepted count; independent control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Canonical direct repayment omitted asset upkeep
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Market owner included capability and upkeep in exact lifetime charge; independent control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Zero-week invoices collected one week late
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Market owner added same-week collection path; independent control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Buyer cost-pass-through share was inverted in price adjustment
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Market owner uses delta cost times expectedPassThrough; independent zero-pass-through control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Competitor offered capacity using cash without subtracting unpaid liabilities
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Source subtracts unpaid liabilities and reserves delivery cost including correction multiplier before offering

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Drain horizon omitted expense delay and stopAfterInsolvency was unused
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Owner rejects unsupported false stopping policy, stops new overhead after insolvency, and drains delayed bills; control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Some behavioral constants live outside config
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Need explicit assumption documentation for bad-quality detection, prior strength, skepticism, competitor reaction and exploration constants

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Full-history cost charged only at later adoption can be retrospective cost recovery
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Default now charges historical construction at opening. At-adoption history allocation is a separately labeled retrospective scenario. Upfront seed exhaustion control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: B/C economic equality is imposed by equal modeled attributes
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Describe as a symmetry result based on no measured differential benefit; not empirical proof equal complete construction efficiency

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Buyer beliefs immediately see true quality, including failures undetected at acceptance
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Owner added scheduled post-delivery feedback and delayed belief/churn updates. Independent delay control passes

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Direct per-use savings and paired causal benefit differ
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Report operating profit, collected cash, direct cost accounting and B-minus-A separately. Direct savings on B uses are a fixed-task counterfactual, not the realized causal market effect. Failure correction multiplier is now included and lifetime cohort unit explicitly labeled

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Null or string numeric costs silently coerced to zero
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Owner added typed numeric validation. A transient scalar-cents check accidentally rejected a valid monetary array, preserved in audit04; corrected source passes null-cost and normal-run controls

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Adoption could be financed in final week despite a known service pause leaving no production horizon
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Counterexample preserved in audit06. Owner subtracts adoption pause from useful horizon and charges forecast foregone incumbent contribution. Audit07 passes zero-horizon and pause controls

source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.finding: Buyer financial resources were not explicit
source_issues_reported_before_primary_ru.resolution: Owner added finite procurement budgets and commitment checks. Zero-budget and cumulative-commitment controls pass

economic_identification_limits: Human time per packet and residual attention duration have not been established by wage sources.
Advertised AI subscriptions and free tools are real alternatives but do not price an equivalent delivered packet.
Study task success counts constrain tested scope; they do not identify field reliability or buyer trust.
A modeled surplus can support conditional adoption without establishing observed revenue or paid demand.
Seed capital, unpaid invoices and customer savings cannot count as collected operating surplus.
A growing balance or scheduler does not establish a second tested capability or self-acceleration.
